scopes.title: Mali GPU
scopes.justification: Active KMD/MGM/protected allocation had no owner. GED, GPU HAL/QoS and gpufreq candidates were generic platform-source triage, not a DONE parity scope; no distinct DONE component owns them.
scopes.effort: Large KMD plus coupled platform ABI; donor-to-stock deltas unmeasured
scopes.prerequisites: GKI-KMI-BASELINE; TMEM-FFA; GZ-TRANSPORT; MTK-TINYSYS-IPI; GPUEB client ABI

scopes.title: APUSYS/NPU
scopes.justification: apusys and apu_top are normal-world source-actionable kernel code, not proprietary algorithms. Prior class-C blob-inventory ownership did not establish source parity; APU/MDLA RPMsg nodes were incorrectly attributed to camera consumers.
scopes.effort: Large multi-object APU stack; power and command/remoteproc ABI first
scopes.prerequisites: GKI-KMI-BASELINE; shared IOMMU/QoS/power providers; signed apusys.img retained

scopes.title: Camera ISP kernel
scopes.justification: Separate ISP/PDA/VMM normal-world kernel work from CAMERA-HAL-ISP's proprietary HAL/3A/tuning boundary. Preserve 16 existing function/data proof pairs and sensor-TU DONE closures; PDA/VMM and whole-module ABI/KCFI/relocation/B1-B2 acceptance remain unclosed.
scopes.effort: Reuse existing function/data-exact sources; bounded PDA/VMM residuals and whole-module acceptance
scopes.prerequisites: GKI-KMI-BASELINE; camera sensor/VCM/EEPROM/OIS DONE children; shared CMDQ/IOMMU/SMI; VCP client ABI

scopes.title: Hardware VCodec
scopes.justification: Four codec/VCU normal-world drivers and their dedicated clock provider have donor targets but no complete module-level source/parity owner. Generic coverage was not a measured reconstruction.
scopes.effort: Common driver then decoder/encoder and VCU; firmware/Codec2 contracts make semantic validation substantial

scopes.title: MDP
scopes.justification: mdp_drv and the two MML modules are distinct from mediatek-drm. The DRM DONE scope explicitly closes DRM/panel modules, not MDP/MML; no MDP byte/semantic parity evidence was found. Keep generic CMDQ and reconstructed secure CMDQ outside this component.
scopes.effort: Four bounded module targets; tile/PQ/CMDQ buffer and display-consumer ABI must be reconciled
scopes.prerequisites: GKI-KMI-BASELINE; existing DRM; generic CMDQ/SMI/IOMMU; VCP host/status

scopes.title: GPU/AI auxiliary processors
scopes.justification: GPUEB and VCP host/status clients were only referenced by MTK-TINYSYS-IPI. Its explicit DONE scope proves the transport module, not these client implementations. SCP and ADSP host code are already DONE elsewhere and are not duplicated.
scopes.effort: Three host modules; finite transport contracts, proprietary remote firmware excluded
scopes.prerequisites: MTK-MBOX; MTK-RPMSG-MBOX; MTK-TINYSYS-IPI; exact GKI; preserve SCP/ADSP DONE owners
